title: Deterministic ooRexx dependency namespace and REXX_PATH
summary: After semantic resolution, Deployment materialises only reachable locked package files into a release-local namespace, verifies component-root and file content authority, emits a deterministic REXX_PATH, and uses the same namespace for package-load verification and final launch. Ambient REXX_PATH is replaced, not inherited.
invariants: Semantic closure and target namespace are separate receipts.
Only explicit entry packages and reachable locked dependency files are materialised unless the whole archive is explicitly the deployable artifact.
A component root with a mismatched authority hash is rejected before publication.
Unsafe relative paths and traversal are rejected.
Every materialised file is hashed and the namespace itself has a verifiable content manifest.
The generated REXX_PATH replaces ambient REXX_PATH unless separately verified external roots are explicitly declared.
Package-load qualification and final process/host activation use the same generated namespace.

provenance.claim: Defines semantic-closure/namespace split, materialisation, root substitution protection and REXX_PATH replacement.
POSIX provider implementation of deterministic namespace materialisation.
Positive namespace and negative substitution/unsatisfied-lock qualification evidence.
